docs/release/producer-release-policy.jso.template: Consumer admission is projected from the lowest minimum in docs/release/runtime-policy.json into package.json engines.node as {{runtime:consumerRange}}. Official support covers the maintained policy families, with minimums of Node {{runtime:minimums}}; other releases receive best-effort support. Freeze the minimum, latest released patch and distinct reference for each policy family once per hosted qualification; require the same retained-tarball scoped/alias consumer contracts on every declared platform and product source behavior on Linux. Producer tools use exact reference runtimes {{runtime:referenceRange}} and npm {{runtime:npm}}; consumer qualification uses separately admitted npm {{runtime:consumerNpm}}. Each report binds actual Node/npm, OS/architecture, source, run/attempt, matrix digest and candidate bytes. Passing hosted evidence supporting the open-ended admission policy is recorded in docs/release/node-consumer-qualification.md; every release candidate still requires its own qualification. Preserve Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}} canonical production and Markdown/Java authority and upstream-support distinctions.

Registry development declarations use stable >= minimums, except the root @hadden-industries/json-quality devDependency uses its exact registry prerelease coordinate for independent installation integrity verification; the exact qualified graph, integrity, authenticated legal evidence and install-script decisions remain locked and reviewed. Local npm eligibility is {{runtime:npmRange}} with versionless devEngines.runtime; producer CI, release and governed verification bootstrap exact npm {{runtime:npm}} before project commands or cache probes. Consumer lanes retain producer-installed tools, then select the frozen Node and separately admitted npm {{runtime:consumerNpm}} without installing the development graph at consumer floors. Preserve production pins, canonical Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}}, denied scripts, Markdown file archives/lock, Python and Actions pins. Deliberate resolution and frozen npm ci are distinct operations.

README.md: > Official support covers the maintained Node.js release lines listed in our [support matrix](docs/release/runtime-policy.json).
The package declares the engine admission range `{{runtime:consumerRange}}`.

The maintained-family minimums of Node {{runtime:minimums}} passed hosted installed-package and native-platform qualification; see the [qualification record](docs/release/node-consumer-qualification.md).
Every release candidate still requires qualification of its own bytes and human release acceptance.
Hosted qualification selects each family's exact minimum and latest released version, plus distinct reference versions, using one frozen matrix and one retained package archive.
Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}} is the selected canonical package producer.

The exact CI reference runtimes remain Node {{runtime:references}}; Node {{runtime:canonicalNode}} is canonical.
